prompt: Please migrate parcel-sieve's internal file pipeline to async functions for the Node 24 release without breaking existing callers. Keep the CommonJS entry point at src/index.js and its exports: runPipeline, processFile, retry, and FileStore. Each exported operation must still accept an optional Node-style error-first callback and must also return a promise. A callback must run exactly once, including on errors, and callback-mode failures must not create unhandled rejections. runPipeline(inputDir, outputDir, options, callback) must keep sorted .txt discovery, the { processed, files } summary, the options.concurrency limit (default 2), options.retries, and the beforeWrite, onFileStart, and onFileDone hooks. Its files array must remain in input-name order even when hooks finish out of order. processFile must keep returning { source, output }. retry(operation, options, callback) must keep options.retries as additional attempts and support the existing error-first operation shape. FileStore must keep readText(file), writeJson(file, value), and ensureDir(dir) in both forms. Keep the JSON format, CLI flags (--input, --output, --concurrency, --retries), stdout wording, and exit codes 0 for success, 1 for processing errors, and 2 for usage errors. Update the project notes for the migration and preserve the no-dependency setup.
